summary: Frontend-only mobile stacking validation for hamburger dropdown on /inscricao-realizada and /pagamento-pix. The dropdown .menu now renders FULLY on top of the green edital card. Confirmed via document.elementFromPoint at center of 'Minhas inscrições' link returns the #seduc-header-host (not .aec-head/.aocp-edital-card). Host computed overflow=visible, zIndex=9999, position=relative. Screenshots captured for both pages. Outside-click close + navigation to /minhas-inscricoes.html verified. Desktop 1920x800 regression on /inscricao.html, /dados-inscricao.html, /confirmacao.html, /minhas-inscricoes.html, /inscricao-realizada.html, /pagamento-pix.html — layouts intact, no header overflow onto page content.

Build was re-run (?v=5 referenced in all 6 HTMLs) and served.
Shadow DOM pierces work with Playwright locators — no change needed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (2 mobile pages: host-overflow, menuVisible, elementFromPoint==host, outside-click close, link navigate) + 6 desktop regression pages
